request.state: Plan task t4: web read aloud on this device (reader listen mode, dock, paragraph-synced progress, continue). Instruction: match the approved mockup, whose dock has Previous, Play/Pause, Next, a device label and a Choose section button. Acceptance criteria: (1) a reading client with the shared auth headers, each unit spoken via /api/speak, heard reported only on the audio ended event, next unit prefetched; (2) pause, audio error, reload, Stop or moving away never report heard (tested with a fake Audio); (3) one dock segment per paragraph, the playing one filling with its audio, the same value driving the edge line and the section map; (4) Continue listening on the library card, a Read aloud card in chat, a gone item says so; text dir=auto, keyboard reachable, reduced motion respected; (5) build, web tests and the no-external-origin check pass. Facts: criteria 1-5 were met when t4 merged (tests, a browser check, the operator's phone check), but the mockup's Choose section button was not built. Now built: with two or more sections the dock lists them by heading or number, marks and focuses the current one, and a choice seeks to that section's first paragraph, reported heard only on ended; Escape closes the list. 4 new tests seen failing then passing; full web suite 531 passed; build and the origin check pass; a 390 px check on a live 304-section book showed the list inside the dock and a choice playing section 8. One unnamed web test failed once in 17 runs on the branch and 0 of 5 on the base. Not yet checked on the operator's phone.
